X.name: Earth
X.description: Všestranná frakce: rakety, štíty, opravy a detekce. Vyrábí rychleji.

Y.name: Mars
Y.description: Těžký pancíř, boj zblízka a těžké dělostřelectvo. Odolná, ale pomalejší.

Z.name: Venus
Z.description: Rychlost, energetické zbraně, maskování a omráčení. Rychlá, ale křehčí.

W.name: Mercury
W.description: Mezi Marsem a Venuší: vyvážená frakce, laserová technologie (vlastní modely zatím nahrazeny).

rocketHeavyTank.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): cannon (muzzle) + roof AA gun (muzzle_2). Balance is a first estimate.

heavyMissileVehicle.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): one big rocket on a raised cradle. Balance is a first estimate.

advancedFighterJet.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): nose gun (muzzle) + wing missiles. Balance is a first estimate.

heavyFighterJet.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): rotary cannon (muzzle_2) + missile block. Balance is a first estimate.

heavyBomber.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): six bomb sockets, tail / dorsal guns are visual only for now. Balance is a first estimate.

lightPlasmaTank.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): plasma gun, can elevate against air. Balance is a first estimate.

electricTank.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): lightning gun between two tesla pylons. Balance is a first estimate.

stealthTank.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): cloaks while standing still and not firing (src/game/Stealth.js: hidden from enemies until detected or it fires). Balance is a first estimate.

stealthJet.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): cloaked also while flying (src/game/Stealth.js). Balance is a first estimate.

lightLaserHover.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): one laser. Balance is a first estimate.

mediumLaserHover.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): main laser (muzzle) + roof AA laser (muzzle_2). Balance is a first estimate.

heavyLaserHover.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): very long laser, long range, no anchoring. Balance is a first estimate.

targetingVehicle.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): support vehicle with a tall dish, no weapons. designationRange (A9-F2, Auras.js / Stealth.js): enemies in range are easier to hit for its alliance (rules.auras.designationAccuracy) and cloaked ones are detected. Balance is a first estimate.

lightLaserJet.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): nose laser, two beam exhausts. Balance is a first estimate.

laserHeavyFighterJet.note: Procedural unit (proc-units-wire.md): two nose lasers (muzzle, muzzle_2). Balance is a first estimate.

outpost.note: Teleport for extra large maps, not used yet. The main building is matterConverter (hq: true).

crewQuarters.note: Crew building of the race with stand-in models (exclusive via races[*].exclusive.structures). Same numbers as cryoFarm; model = placeholder (cryoFarm GLB of its modelRace) until a procedural one is registered under this id.

aaTurret.note: Anti-air only, strong. Model is a procedural one (registry); the PDS GLB is only the footprint / fallback.

reconTower.note: Common building. Detection reveals cloaked enemies within radius (src/game/Stealth.js, finished and powered).

powerGenerator.note: Strong energy source. Destroyed (when finished) = huge explosion hurting nearby buildings and units, see `explosion` (Combat.structureBlast). Model is procedural; the Outpost GLB is only the footprint / fallback.

oreDeepExtractor.note: Built anywhere (user 2026-11-24); produces ore endlessly, slower than a drill truck (Economy, docs/notes/h3-deep-extractor.md). Model is procedural; the PDS GLB is only the footprint / fallback.

attackEnhancer.note: A9: aura (src/game/Auras.js): +value share of damage dealt. Stand-in GLB scaled to ~reconTower size (modelScale 0.3, simBody = GLB × 0.3) until the procedural model (B3).

defenseEnhancer.note: A9: aura (Auras.js): value = change of damage taken (-0.10 = 10 % less), units and buildings. Stand-in GLB × 0.3.

reconEnhancer.note: A9: aura (Auras.js): +value share of unit sight range; detection of cloaked units within the radius (Stealth.js). Stand-in GLB × 0.3.

constructionEnhancer.note: A9: aura (Auras.js): value = build / repair speed bonus of buildings, productionValue = production speed bonus of buildings in range (not research). Stand-in GLB × 0.3.

imagingPole.note: A9: unarmed watch post; sightRange 150 reveals the fog of war (no terrain line-of-sight in the fog, so no extra code).

archeologyStation.note: A9: finished + powered: salvage analysis time ÷ analysisSpeed; vehicleWrecks = enemy vehicles destroyed in the team's sight become analysable loot that unlocks a foreign vehicle (Research.js).

orbitalBomb.note: A9: superweapon (F3, src/game/Superweapons.js). Exclusive X, W (W uses the X model).

neutronBomb.note: A9: superweapon of the super tier (F3), every faction.
